ntq.title: PA/GA speakers quiet – attenuator rating and speaker tap differ from design
ntq.problem: Site check found Inter-M ATT-03 attenuators (3 W, 3-wire) installed. The attenuator list gives 30 W attenuators for LSW-402, 403, 404, 406, 407, 414 and 415, and several of these speakers are designed at 5 W or 10 W. A 3 W attenuator limits these speakers. Speakers with a 3 W attenuator are designed on the 2.5 W (white) lead, which is the lowest tap, so they are quiet by design.

GGSO-001 sh.39: lead colour Red 10 W / Brown 5 W / White 2.5 W, 0 V Black; EM line must be connected
Site 28.10.2026: label on installed attenuators = ATT-03, 3 W
ntq.proposal: Confirm the attenuator rating for LSW-402, 403, 404, 406, 407, 414, 415 (30 W per sh.21) and supply 30 W attenuators where required. Confirm whether the speakers on 3 W attenuators may be connected on a higher tap if the client finds the volume too low.

Cabinet earth bolt to the earth strip with PuGVng(A)-LS 1x6 mm; earth strip 300 mm above floor. (GLE-G0-D1810BX0-EL-EG02-ZA-001 sh.5)

Marshalling / I/O / system cabinets: PE bar via 6 mm² and 16 mm² yellow-green PE with black heat-shrink; instrument (FE) bar separate; links between systems earthed in the higher-level cabinet. (GLE-G0-D1810BX0-EL-EG02-ZA-001 sh.5)
checks: PE and FE bars not mixed

images.caption: Cabinet installation on raised floor and on concrete floor
Earthing of marshalling / system cabinets (PE and FE)

inst.title: Cable trays, ladders, supports (Лотки, кабельные конструкции)
remarks: Ladder trays fixed to supports with clamps; trays and fittings joined with bolts, nuts and washers – joints must give continuous metal bonding. (GLE-G0-D1810BX0-EL-EMSV-ZA-001 sh.7)
Floor cable stands fixed with chemical anchors, pitch 1 m; shelves clip to stands without bolts. (GLE-G0-D1810BX0-EL-EMSV-ZA-001 sh.11)
Earth the tray to the supporting steel in two places along each indoor run; touch up cut and welded parts with zinc spray. (GLE-G0-D1810BX0-EL-EMSV-ZA-001 sh.11)
Welded earth connections must stay accessible for inspection. (GLE-G0-D1810BX0-EL-EMSV-ZA-001 sh.11)

images.caption: Tray brackets on drywall cladding

inst.title: Cable transits / fire sealing (Кабельные проходки, MCT)
remarks: MCT frames are EI 60, with sleeve, flange, bolted sleeve attachment and earthing; sealing modules with core sized to the cable OD. (GLE-G0-D1810BX0-EL-EMSV-ZA-001 sh.17)
Openings: fire pillows on main routes where cables are added often; sealant on rarely changed routes; sealant 10 mm deep on each side. (GLE-G0-D1810BX0-TE-SKST-001 sh.19)
Fire alarm cables through walls only in certified fire-resistant Ex multi-cable transits. (GLE-G0-D1801FX0-FA-PSGN-001 sh.35)

images.caption: Sealing openings with fire pillows / sealant
Single cable through wall: sleeve Ø25 + intumescent foam

inst.title: Earthing and bonding (Заземление)
remarks: Indoor earth strip 40x5 galvanized on walls with dowel nails 8x60 at 1000 mm pitch. (GLE-G0-D1810BX0-EL-EG02-ZA-001 sh.5)
Strip through walls in sleeve, sleeve sealed with mounting foam. (GLE-G0-D1810BX0-EL-EG02-ZA-001 sh.5)
Incoming pipes B1, B2, T1, T2 bonded on the flange nearest the entrance (M16 stud through the strip); check more than 1.5 free threads above the nut. (GLE-G0-D1810BX0-EL-EG02-ZA-001 sh.5)
Raised-floor and PE/FE bars: PE 6 mm² and 16 mm² yellow-green with black heat-shrink. (GLE-G0-D1810BX0-EL-EG02-ZA-001 sh.5)
checks: Bolted joints tight with spring washers

images.caption: Equipment / cabinet earthing to wall strip
Marshalling cabinet PE/FE earthing

inst.title: Telecom outlets RJ45 (Розетки телекоммуникационные) USN-RJ
remarks: Outlet heights differ by location: H=300, H=1200, H=2500, H=5400 or floor box – read H= at the tag on the plan. (GLE-G0-D1810BX0-TE-SKST-001 sh.17)
Wall outlets on solid walls use back box D65x45; floor outlets are 4-port in floor hatches. (GLE-G0-D1810BX0-TE-SKST-001 sh.17)

install_notes.note: Use certified fire-rated multi-cable transits for cable wall penetrations; MCT types and installation height are shown on the plans.
Each KP transit has its own material table (frame + modules) and opening size under the detail - pack modules exactly as listed and fill unused space with blind modules.
Cable layout per transit (П1-П26) is on the "Multi-cable transits. Cable routing" sheet; elevation shown is from ground level; cables marked * are covered by EMSV-ZA-002.
Frame/compression/sealing module quantities for EMSV transits are in the MTO on sheet 24 (frames pos.29-52, compression modules pos.53-54, stayplates pos.55-56, sealing modules pos.57-63).
Earthing strip passes through building walls in sleeves of galvanized pipe (item 22).
Single cables pass through walls in sleeves provided by the architectural design (AR-AR02); fire-resistant cable penetrations to be made per the typical details album.
Seal cable route passages through walls with fire-retardant foam only after cables of all communication systems are laid; fit fire-stop barriers inside cable boxes.

Seal wall openings with fire-resistant pillows (120x100x25) and fire-resistant sealant only after all cables are laid; pillow count per opening is calculated on the sheet (e.g. 24 pillows per 400x200 opening with two trays).

ASUE MCT frame kits (Type 1/2/4) come with mating frame/support plate, press block, assembly grease and sealing tape; Type 3 is Ex-rated with flange, bolted. Mounting opening and number of Ø10 fixing holes are given per type.
